about: The fixed script of `cargo xtask bridge` (T-134). Each element is one request to the bridge: an object is sent as the JSON text of the object, a string is sent as it stands (so that a request that is not JSON can be in the script). In a parameter, {"$file": "path"} is replaced by the text of that file, the path being relative to the workspace root. The script runs on a new engine, in this order, through Engine::execute in Rust, through the WebAssembly module under Node and through the command handler of the Tauri shell; the three lists of answers must be the same bytes. Objects are numbered in the order they are made: the worksheet is 1, the NCA 2, the plot 3.
